p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, business start-ups, investment platforms: official resources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens the updated official sources, and then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): product and country-specific customs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Chart (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health rules that the country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade to and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a business, taxes, international trade, countries by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that the regulator has not marked the platform before you entrust your money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: Pages open in your language: use the browser translation or the "Understanding Document" function for documents.For an important decision, ask an expert in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: A guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Commitments and Rules for Nearly All Countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea Freight), Air Freight (Air Freight), CMR (Road Freight)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Proof of origin (for customs duty reduction)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (enterprises importing or exporting to the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, permit, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer deals everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods, cleared for export, to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; the risk and costs are then borne by the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the transport and insurance costs to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and can be applied for.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD itself does not send money and does not earn anything from these links: here you compare and then send with the service you choose.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance costs worldwide (World Bank): the actual cost of sending money, by country and service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market rate, fees shown before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Check the total amount you received: fees + exchange rate, because the exchange rate is worse than the market hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identification document is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling products that the supplier sends directly to your customer. It's easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customer’s country: no counterfeit products, no regulated products without approval.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale / Supplier" here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT in the buyer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Inform your customers of the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect the rights of customers: clear prices with taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package coming from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
